response.sql: SELECT c.circuitId, c.country, AVG(r.round) as circuit_avg_round, AVG(r.round) - (SELECT AVG(r2.round) FROM races r2 JOIN circuits c2 ON r2.circuitId = c2.circuitId WHERE c2.country = c.country) as difference FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId GROUP BY c.circuitId, c.country ORDER BY difference IS NULL, difference DESC LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: NULL values in races.round are excluded from AVG() calculations per standard SQL behavior.
